hero.headline: Vietnam – Timeless Roots, Boundless Tomorrow

about.title: About Vietnam
about.narrative: Vietnam, a land steeped in over 4,000 years of history, is home to more than 100 ethnic groups and over 100 million resilient people. Its spiritual heritage blends Buddhist tranquility, Confucian wisdom, and vibrant folk traditions. Today, Vietnam embraces rapid modern development, technological growth, and economic rise, creating a unique tapestry where ancient wonders coexist with contemporary innovation.
